name: What are the common types of multi-generational living units that AKN Design Group constructs?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of multi-generational living units that AKN Design Group constructs?

acceptedAnswer.text: We construct various types of multi-generational living units, ranging from primary suite additions with private entrances and kitchenettes to garage conversions and basement build-outs. Our approach involves understanding your family's specific needs to create customized solutions that may include dedicated living areas, accessible bathrooms, or separate laundry facilities. The goal is always a harmonious blend of shared family life and individual privacy, ensuring the new space integrates seamlessly with your home's existing aesthetic and structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group builds various multi-generational living units, including primary suite additions, garage conversions, and basement build-outs, all customized to family needs and integrated seamlessly with the existing home.
